# Fork-owned work that an upstream merge must keep. scripts/check-fork-manifest.sh checks it.
# One entry per line: a repo path, then optionally a TAB and text that file must still contain.
# A directory path must exist. Every code comment that starts with "Fork:" must sit in a listed
# file, so add new fork overrides here. See docs/operations/fork-releases.md.
